summary: Single-line text input with a built-in label and supporting text, for text, search, email, url, password, tel, number or date entry.

usage.text: The required, type, pattern, min, max, step, minlength and maxlength attributes feed validity. Whitespace-only text counts as missing when required. A readonly field is never reported invalid, even with invalid set.
The change event fires when the native input commits: on blur after an edit, or on Enter.
There is no error-text attribute and no error message is rendered: invalid only turns the border red and sets aria-invalid. Put the error wording in supporting-text while invalid.
The before slot holds leading inline content such as a search icon; mark an icon there decorative so it is not read.

a11y.text: An aria-describedby on the host is resolved against ids in the host's own root and applied to the inner input together with the supporting text, in browsers with ARIA element reflection.
